title: Advanced Manufacturing Training Demo
tagline: Practice metrology and manufacturing procedures inside an interactive virtual workcell.
overview: The Advanced Manufacturing Training Demo recreates a technical workcell where a learner can interact with metrology equipment, fixtures, controls, workstation displays, and tools in an immersive environment. The supplied scenes focus on guided setup and measurement tasks rather than passive visualization.

project.name: Honeywell - Advanced Manufacturing Training Demo
project.blurb: This advanced-manufacturing experience turns a specialized metrology workflow into step-by-step immersive practice. The supplied imagery shows a Navigator One measurement system, measurement fixtures, operator controls, a dual-monitor workstation, and interactive tool selection inside a virtual workcell. By modeling the equipment and sequence in context, the experience demonstrates how technical training can support equipment recognition, setup, measurement practice, and procedural familiarity before a learner works at the physical station.
